feedback_request.integration_feedback: State whether any controller change was needed to run this geometry on the unseen track. Report line_loss_events on s-bend and slalom against 0.9 and 1.0, and report the oval progress against 0.242. Note whether the line losses come from the forward row or from curve speed, and whether any geometry change you would make would be safe to try without a race.

intent: Hold the iteration 9 geometry unchanged (y=0.045, ±0.055 span, 16 mm footprints, 0.12 m track, 0.035 m wheels, 0.6 kg, 0.16 x 0.12 m body) as the final-iteration design, since it is the best-measured platform (score 67.70). Geometry is not changed, so the race result reflects the Integrator's controller on this platform.
learning: Across 11 iterations, the forward sensor row was the only geometry lever that moved bend progress (s-bend 0.040 at y=0.03 to about 0.146 at y=0.045 to 0.06). Line losses appeared at every forward row tested with a span of ±0.055 or ±0.05 (y=0.045 to 0.06), and none at y=0.03 with ±0.05. Span, track, wheel radius, mass, lookahead and footprint did not move the max_error floor near 0.060 to 0.063. The best geometry is y=0.045 with ±0.055 and base_speed 1.4, which is the platform raced here.
rationale: Iteration 9 is the best-scoring geometry so far (67.70). It uses y=0.045 with outer sensors at x=±0.055, 16 mm footprints, a 0.12 m track, 0.035 m wheels and 0.6 kg mass. Its controller change (base_speed 1.4) lifted oval progress to 0.242 and the score, but its line losses persisted at 0.9 on s-bend and 1.0 on slalom. Iteration 10 (y=0.05, ±0.06) scored lower (60.55), with slalom progress down to 0.103 and a slalom loss, so widening the span and moving the row did not help. The max_error floor near 0.060 to 0.063 has not moved under any geometry change (span, track, radius, mass, lookahead, ki), and body width cannot raise the off-track limit within range. So no geometry lever I can test is likely to change the outcome on an unseen track. This is the final iteration and the final race runs on unseen tracks, so I am choosing the best-measured geometry rather than an untested one. I keep iteration 9's geometry exactly, so any difference in the race comes from the Integrator's controller alone. I expect a score near 65 to 68 on the development tracks, and the unseen track is uncertain.
